cohort: The study included 197 women aged 18 to 70 years (average 40.7 years) who underwent surgery for urogenital and rectovaginal fistulas in a national center in Togo over a five-year period.
finding: Urogenital fistulas in Togo are principally caused by obstetric conditions, with multiparity identified as a risk factor; surgical treatment, though often delayed by an average of 10 years, achieves a good recovery rate of 78.1%.
mod_finding: Caesarean section was necessary in 70% of the obstetrical cases leading to fistula, which was associated with a high rate of fetal mortality (88.2%).
